content: Nevini mafaꞌneꞌamo Apasalomiꞌa hafaiꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo Neviniꞌmo nunumu huꞌniya gemae
Ala kava nene, huꞌna, Vaehae, kame vayaꞌnimo magoꞌe magoꞌe huꞌa asole vayaꞌmo afole neꞌaiye. Asole vayaꞌmo natale uꞌa kame huꞌa neꞌnatae.
Apakaemo nagaefeꞌmo, Gotiꞌa ha oꞌmaegaiye, huꞌa nehae.
Nehayaꞌmonanafa Ala kava nene, kagaemo haleguꞌnimo maiꞌnane. Kagaekeꞌmo naha maeꞌnanageꞌna aeꞌna neꞌapakasove. Kagaekeꞌmo alika he tika neꞌnatana vekamo maiꞌnane.
Nagaemo Ala kava nefekeꞌmo alopa gefatiꞌmo keya aeꞌna ge nehugenoꞌaeꞌmo aote aveleꞌmo mono noꞌafatiꞌmo neꞌafiye.
Muki haniꞌilagamo hipaꞌnileꞌmo haiꞌna nauꞌmo nekalogenoꞌaeꞌmo Ala kava neꞌmoꞌa yagaino neꞌnate.
Asole kame vayaꞌnimogimo faiꞌa ku aiꞌa neꞌnatayaꞌmonanafa koliꞌapimo nosuve.
Ala kava nene, Gotiꞌnimogamo, he tika nagufamo alika katika nato. Kagaemo muki kame vayaꞌnimo kayoꞌmo neꞌapaminagenoꞌaeꞌmo lokiyaꞌapimo alagi hano nehiyanageꞌa oꞌnahaegae.
Kagaekeꞌmo lagufamo alika katika nelatane. Vayaꞌamo fiku hapa maeno apamino.
